description: Known error patterns and their resolutions. ChaosMender and the self-healing routine read this file to detect and auto-fix recurring failures without human intervention.

errors.title: removeLabel 404 crashes github-script job mid-sweep
errors.symptom: HttpError: Label does not exist (404) — github-script job dies mid-sweep, leaving all remaining stuck issues unprocessed for that pass
errors.root_cause: Bare github.rest.issues.removeLabel call without a 404-swallowing .catch guard. A racing workflow (e.g. wr-auto-classify, wr-field-filler's wr:reset cycle, or a manual relabel) removes the label between the issue fetch and the removeLabel call. The REST API returns 404; github-script treats any thrown HttpError as fatal; the entire job aborts.
errors.fix: Wrap every removeLabel call in .catch(err => { if (err.status !== 404) throw err; }) so the desired end state (label absent) is treated as idempotent success. A 401/403 must still surface — swallow ONLY 404.
errors.detection_note: scripts/chaosmender.js walks each github.rest.issues.removeLabel call expression and accepts a guard only if it re-throws everything that is not a 404 — either a chained .catch or an enclosing try/catch. .catch(() => {}) is REJECTED: it swallows 401/403, which is the defect this rule exists to prevent. A widened condition such as '!== 404 && !== 403' is rejected for the same reason. veins-monitor.yml's removeLabelSafe wrapper exempts calls inside the wrapper only, not the whole file. Fixed in #17787.

errors.title: gh CLI unauthenticated — missing GH_TOKEN env
errors.symptom: gh: authentication required, or silent 401/403 failures in gh CLI commands
errors.root_cause: Job using the gh CLI without a GH_TOKEN env variable. Runs unauthenticated, hitting rate limits or auth errors. Also: default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot trigger downstream workflow_dispatch events — use ADMIN_GITHUB_TOKEN for healing actions that cascade.
errors.fix: Set GH_TOKEN with PAT fallback at workflow or job env level.

errors.title: gh CLI fails with 'not a git repository' on jobs without checkout
errors.symptom: fatal: not a git repository ... exit 1 from gh commands in jobs with no actions/checkout step
errors.root_cause: gh infers target repo from the local git remote. Without a checkout step, there is no remote config file. gh has nothing to read and aborts.
errors.fix: Set GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }} in job or workflow env. Exemption: gh api calls that use a full literal path are not affected.

errors.title: github-script REST calls without owner/repo return 404
errors.symptom: GET /repos///issues 404 — all REST calls return 404 for missing owner/repo path segments
errors.root_cause: github.rest.issues.listForRepo and similar calls made without passing owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo. GitHub's REST client templates the URL as /repos/{owner}/{repo}/... — if the fields are empty, it resolves to /repos///...
errors.fix: Always pass owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo to every github.rest.* call.
errors.detection_note: No reliable static heuristic — requires semantic analysis of the full github-script context. Caught by existing tests (tests/workflow-yaml-validation.test.js) which assert owner/repo are passed in known workflows.

errors.title: workflow_run event without 'workflows:' list causes startup_failure
errors.symptom: Workflow run fails in 0 seconds with no jobs — GitHub rejects the file at parse time, every push triggers a silent failure
errors.root_cause: workflow_run event declared without the required workflows: list. The Actions schema requires it; without it GitHub treats the file as invalid and rejects every run at startup.
errors.fix: Add workflows: [<exact workflow name>] under the workflow_run trigger.
errors.detection_note: Detected by scripts/check-workflow-yaml.js (Actions-schema check, not plain YAML validation). Also runs in CI via ci-error-prevention.yml.

errors.title: github-script multi-line script body at column 0 terminates YAML block scalar
errors.symptom: Workflow Lint (CircleCI + ci-error-prevention) fails on every PR — often pointing at a file the PR never touched
errors.root_cause: A github-script script: | block whose template literal continuation lines are written flush-left (column 0). In YAML, a line at column 0 inside an indented block scalar terminates the scalar. The YAML is syntactically valid but the Actions schema gets a truncated script.
errors.fix: Keep all github-script body lines indented inside the block. Build multi-line strings as indented array.join('\n'), never as raw template literals with column-0 continuations.
errors.detection_note: Detected by python3 -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open(f))' on each .yml file. Also caught by node scripts/check-workflow-yaml.js.
